description: This is a test module for the Go SDK CLI integration, using pytest and asyncio to verify control-plane registration, execution, and workflow DAG creation. It tests both server mode and local calls, including health checks and workflow state polling.

methods.name: _wait_for_registration(client, node_id: str, timeout: float = 30.0)
methods.description: Polls the client until a node with specified node_id is registered successfully or timeout occurs.

methods.name: _wait_for_workflow_run(client, run_id: str, *, expected_reasoners: set[str], timeout: float = 45.0)
methods.description: Polls the workflow run endpoint until the expected reasoners appear in executions or timeout occurs.

methods.name: _wait_for_workflow_run_completed( client, run_id: str, *, expected_reasoners: set[str], timeout: float = 45.0 )
methods.description: Polls until the workflow run reaches a succeeded state with the expected reasoners.

methods.name: _wait_for_agent_health(url: str, timeout: float = 20.0)
methods.description: Checks agent health endpoint until healthy or timeout.

methods.name: str _resolve_workflow_id_from_execution(client, execution_id: str, timeout: float = 15.0)
methods.description: Resolves the canonical workflow or run ID based on an execution ID.

methods.name: test_go_sdk_cli_and_control_plane(async_http_client, control_plane_url)
methods.description: Integration test verifying Go SDK server mode operation, control plane registration, execution, and CLI invocation.

methods.name: test_go_sdk_local_calls_emit_workflow_events(async_http_client, control_plane_url)
methods.description: Test ensuring local calls emit proper workflow events for DAG construction.

ctags.name: _wait_for_workflow_run
ctags.pattern: /^async def _wait_for_workflow_run(client, run_id: str, *, expected_reasoners: set[str], timeout: /
ctags.signature: (client, run_id: str, *, expected_reasoners: set[str], timeout: float = 45.0)

ctags.name: _wait_for_workflow_run_completed
ctags.signature: ( client, run_id: str, *, expected_reasoners: set[str], timeout: float = 45.0 )
